mapper.select:
select u.user_id, u.nick_name, u.user_name, u.avatar, u.sex, u.member_no, u.member_department, u.member_title, u.member_cohort, u.student_no, u.class_name, u.is_quanta_member from sys_user u where u.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.is_quanta_member = '1'
and ( u.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') or u.user_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') or u.member_department like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') or u.member_no like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%') )
and u.member_department like concat('%', #{memberDepartment}, '%')
and u.member_cohort = #{memberCohort}
order by u.member_cohort desc, u.member_no asc, u.user_id asc
